About Bubble Shooter

This is not a solo level climb — it is a head-to-head duel across two bubble fields. Every clear sends pressure to the other side, and one well-placed shot on a key connector can drop an entire cluster.

JoyFlock adds an easy computer opponent and friend rooms, with its own aim line, landing preview and cascade feedback.

How to play

  1. Move the mouse to aim and click to fire a bubble.
  2. Three or more matching colours pop; any cluster detached from the ceiling falls as a group.
  3. Pops and drops push the opponent's field down. First field to reach the bottom line loses; clearing your own field wins immediately.

Frequently asked questions

How is this different from solo bubble shooter?
It is head-to-head: your clears push the opponent's field down, and the bottom line decides the winner.
Can I practise alone?
Yes — start a computer match at the easy level.
Does it work on touchscreens?
Yes — tap to aim and fire.
